# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.8 Worker 1: imperial manufactories, production methods and market demands (oe_mfg_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v118_manufactories.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Adds a temporary special demand to the capital's market. demand = key, years = N.
oe_mfg_inject_demand = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = market }
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = {
						type = demand:$demand$
						years = $years$
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Called by Slot 89 (W2) for a handful of countries each quarter: fires at most one story event the
# country has not seen and whose condition holds.
oe_mfg_story_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mfg_ev3_done }
			has_advance = oe_mfg_adv_imperial_ordnance
			any_owned_location = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_imperial_arsenal_foundry }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mfg_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mfg.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mfg_ev6_done }
			any_owned_location = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_venetian_arsenale_glassworks }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mfg_ev6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mfg.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mfg_ev7_done }
			has_advance = oe_mfg_adv_royal_karkhaneh
			any_owned_location = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_imperial_silk_ergasterion }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mfg_ev7_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mfg.7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mfg_ev8_done }
			any_owned_location = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_karkhaneh_wootz_calico }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mfg_ev8_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mfg.8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mfg_ev9_done }
			current_year >= 1600
			any_owned_location = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_jingdezhen_imperial_kiln }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mfg_ev9_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mfg.9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mfg_ev10_cd }
			at_war = yes
			any_owned_location = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_imperial_arsenal_foundry }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mfg_ev10_cd years = 25 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mfg.10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mfg_ev11_done }
			has_advance = oe_mfg_adv_rifled_arsenal
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mfg_ev11_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mfg.11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mfg_ev12_done }
			current_year >= 1700
			oe_mfg_has_any_manufactory = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mfg_ev12_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mfg.12
	}
}

# Dev page 84: research the four manufactory advances.
oe_mfg_dev_unlock_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_mfg_adv_imperial_ordnance } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_mfg_adv_imperial_ordnance
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_mfg_adv_royal_karkhaneh } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_mfg_adv_royal_karkhaneh
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_mfg_adv_ural_metallurgy } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_mfg_adv_ural_metallurgy
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_mfg_adv_rifled_arsenal } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_mfg_adv_rifled_arsenal
	}
}

# Dev page 84: build one level of every manufactory the capital allows (free, instant).
oe_mfg_dev_build_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_imperial_silk_ergasterion } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_mfg_imperial_silk_ergasterion
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_mfg_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_imperial_arsenal_foundry } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_mfg_imperial_arsenal_foundry
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_mfg_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_jingdezhen_imperial_kiln } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_mfg_jingdezhen_imperial_kiln
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_mfg_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_ural_demidov_ironworks } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_mfg_ural_demidov_ironworks
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_mfg_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_venetian_arsenale_glassworks } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_mfg_venetian_arsenale_glassworks
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_mfg_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_mfg_karkhaneh_wootz_calico } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_mfg_karkhaneh_wootz_calico
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_mfg_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

}
